mods.name: Mods Menu
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Framework that adds a MODS tab to Settings; other mods register toggles, lists, and buttons into it. On its own it shows nothing — the tab only appears once another mod registers a row.

mods.name: Four Player
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Local and Remote Play co-op for up to 4 players — dynamic join screen, extra ships and HUDs, and the ready-up profile picker.

mods.name: Punk Multiverse
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Online co-op and battle royale for PUNK — entity replication, dedicated servers, lobby and direct connect, ring schedule and contested loot.

mods.name: Combat Tweaks Extended
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Combat feel tweaks with in-game toggles — suppress the slow-motion on player damage and remove all camera screen shake.

mods.name: Drones Enhanced
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Smarter, commandable drones. HOLD POSITION parks a drone where you stand, DEFEND OWNER makes drones attack anything hostile to you, and TARGET NEAREST locks the closest visible enemy. All three on by default.

mods.name: Dash I-Frames
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Grants a short window of invincibility while dashing, so you can dash through lasers and bullets.

mods.name: Revive Item
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Adds the Revive Beacon, a 2500-coin shop consumable that revives a random downed player at the user's position.

mods.name: Scoreboard
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Hold Tab for a co-op scoreboard — per-player kills, bosses, deaths, damage dealt, time alive, HP, and fuel.

mods.name: Player Highlight
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Draws a neon ring and a P1–P4 label around each player's ship so you can spot yourself quickly.

mods.name: Meta Loadout
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Persists each player's ship build per class and profile across runs; profiles are chosen on the player-select screen.

mods.name: Seed Picker
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Adds a world-seed entry screen after class selection so you can type or randomize the run's seed.

mods.name: Sell Vault Items
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Hover a spare module in the Vault and press the north face button (Y / Triangle) to sell it back for its base shop buy price, credited to your run currency.

mods.name: Input Tweaks
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Raises the Input System polling rate to cut gamepad input latency (helps controller and Remote Play players).

mods.name: UI Fixes
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Fixes vanilla UI alignment, e.g. the co-op ASSIGN INPUT header drifting on ultrawide aspect ratios.

mods.name: Debug Menu Key
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Opens the game's built-in developer debug menu with F1.

mods.name: Sim Controller
mods.author: Trihardest
mods.description: Debug tool that spawns simulated controllers to test the co-op join and start flow without extra hardware.

mods.name: Weapon Forge
mods.author: Sugarheady
mods.description: Build custom weapons from small JSON files — no C#, no compiling. Clones a real in-game weapon as a template and applies your stats on top, plus orbit rings, wave motion, turrets, chain lightning, phasing and sub-emitters.
